meta_title: Hull City Plumbing | Emergency Plumber Hull
meta_description: Hull City Plumbing provides emergency plumbing repairs, installations and maintenance across Hull. Same-day callouts, Gas Safe registered. Call 07939 224908.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am in Hull? We arrive within 60 minutes, any day of the week, to stop the damage.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to new installations, we handle everything plumbing — residential and commercial.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes
services.desc: Water damage spreads fast. We're on standby 24/7 to locate the leak, stop the flow, and repair or replace the pipework. Most calls resolved in under two hours.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Installation
services.desc: Gas Safe certified heating engineers. We repair failed boilers same day and install new A-rated condensing models that cut fuel bills and come with 10-year warranties.

services.title: Bathroom Suites & Tiling
services.desc: Full bathroom renovations from design to handover. We fit suites, tile walls and floors, and plumb everything in to building regs standard.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold spots in radiators? We bleed them, add inhibitor, and repair or replace faulty valves and thermostats to restore heat flow.

services.title: Leaking Taps & Toilet Cisterns
services.desc: Persistent drips waste water and money. We replace cartridges, washers, and internal components to stop leaks and save you up to £200 per year.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Powerflush, chemical clean, and system balancing to restore flow and efficiency. Ideal before fitting a new boiler or if your radiators are slow to heat up.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I hated seeing locals overcharged by cowboys.
about_para_1: Hull City Plumbing was founded in 2008 by a Gas Safe engineer frustrated with inflated callout fees and poor customer service across East Yorkshire. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation for honest pricing, rapid response, and workmanship that lasts. Today, we're the go-to emergency plumbers for hundreds of Hull households and businesses.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is speed and transparency. You'll get a fixed quote before we start, no hidden extras, and honest advice on whether to repair or replace. We carry spare parts on every van so most jobs finish the same day. Our customers come back because we treat their home with genuine care.
reviews_heading: What Hull Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a leaking radiator before Christmas. Jake came out the same evening and had it sorted in 45 minutes. Brilliant bloke, fair price. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Called at 3am with a burst pipe. They were here by 4:15am and had stopped the leak within an hour. No fuss, no drama, just professional work. Can't thank them enough.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Quoted £450 for a new boiler install. Finished on time, tested everything, and walked me through the controls. Saved me £300 compared to the big names. Honest traders—rare these days.
reviews.author: Margaret P.
